answer: A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 15 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a vine bet on surviving 51 epochs of grading, and every zephyr settlement recomputes the pearl schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 51 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 14 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
